home.heroSubtitle: Thousands of verified listings from trusted agents across {country}.
home.searchPlaceholder: Search a location, area or building name
home.whyVerifiedBody: Every listing is reviewed before it goes live, with the agent's verification status shown.
home.whyFastBody: Agents are ranked on how quickly they reply, not just how much they list.
home.whyProtectedBody: Your contact details go only to the agent handling the property you asked about.
home.promotedSubtitle: These listings were promoted by their agent. The position is paid for — the listing itself is reviewed like any other.
home.byTypeSubtitle: Counts below are of listings live right now.
home.byCitySubtitle: Where the most properties are listed today.

kpr.title: Estimate your mortgage
kpr.intro: Work out the monthly instalment before you start looking. Drag to adjust.
kpr.disclaimer: A rough estimate at a fixed rate. Your actual instalment depends on the bank, the rate structure, insurance and arrangement fees.

home.browseTypeSubtitle: Find the kind of property you need
home.agentCtaBody: Grow your business with us: manage your listings, receive qualified leads, and put your properties in front of more buyers.
home.heroSubtitle2: Describe your ideal home in plain words. Our property assistant turns it into a real search across verified listings in {country}.
home.conciergePlaceholder: e.g. a 3-bedroom house in Depok under Rp2 billion
home.conciergeExample1: 3-bedroom house in Depok under Rp2 billion
home.conciergeExample2: Rent a furnished apartment in South Jakarta
home.conciergeExample3: Villa with a pool in Bali
home.featuredSubtitle: The newest verified listings on the platform.
home.conciergeBandBody: Type a sentence — budget, rooms, area, type — and the assistant turns it into real filters, shows exactly what matched, and offers the closest alternatives when nothing fits.
home.step1Body: “Rent a 2-bedroom apartment in South Jakarta under Rp15 million a month.”
home.step2Body: Every criterion we understood is shown as a chip. Nothing is hidden or guessed.
home.step3Body: Put up to four properties side by side, then send one inquiry straight to the agent.
home.ruleBody: During this pilot the assistant uses deterministic rules, not a language model. It never invents listings, scores or recommendations.

concierge.title: Describe the property you want
concierge.subtitle: A sentence is enough. The assistant turns it into real filters, shows what it understood, and finds the closest matches.
concierge.nothingParsed: We could not pick out a budget, area, type or room count from that. Try something like “3-bedroom house in Depok under Rp2 billion”.

concierge.compareHint: Tip: tap “Compare” on up to four cards, then open the comparison from the bar at the bottom.

compare.title: Compare properties
compare.subtitle: Verified listing attributes only, in one table. Highlights follow a stated rule, never a guess.
compare.emptyBody: Pick up to four properties from search results or the assistant with the “Compare” button, then come back here.
compare.ruleBody: “Lowest price”, “largest” and “newest” are simple comparisons of the numbers the agents supplied. They are not advice.
compare.mixedNotice: This comparison mixes sale and rental listings (or different rent periods), so prices are shown but not ranked against each other.
compare.addMore: You can add more properties to this comparison.
